frame_duration_ms.description: GIF only. Duration of each frame in milliseconds, at least 20 and rounded to 10 ms steps. Omitted uses 200.
frame_duration_ms.title: Frame Duration (ms)

frame_size.description: GIF only. Pixel width x height of each frame, for example 512x512. The width and height you set here also decide the GIF's aspect ratio. Both edges must be multiples of 16; omitted or auto currently means 512x512. Aspect-ratio names such as 1:1 are not accepted. Frames are tiled into one sheet per animation: the sheet must have edges at most 3840, at most 8,294,400 pixels in total and an aspect ratio at most 3:1; larger sheets are rejected at submission and are not charged. 512x512 supports 2-16 frames; 768x768 supports at most 12 frames.
